statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (4/7 + e)

brief.zh: 对所有偶数 4≤n≤X 计数。公开基准为 Pintz–Althöfer v1 的 7/12；本题证明 4/7，节省 1/84，且不假设统一零点自由半平面。另一路径是直接控制例外集。
brief.en: Count all even integers in [4,X] that are not sums of two primes. Save 1/84 in the exponent against Pintz–Althöfer v1, with no zero-free hypothesis. Direct exceptional-set arguments are welcome.
